title: Term, Notice and Early Termination Schedule for Resort Club Memberships
content:
Schedule to the Resort Club Memberships agreement: the minimum term, the cancellation notice period, the basis of the early termination charge and the relocation distance for each membership level.

| Membership level | Minimum term (months from the start date) | Cancellation notice period (calendar days) | Basis of the early termination charge | Early termination charge under the flat fee basis (USD) | Permanent move from the resort beyond which the charge is waived (miles) | Cancellation and freeze notices take effect only once signed by the member |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 6 | 30 | Flat fee | 150.00 | 50 | Yes |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 12 | 30 | Flat fee | 250.00 | 50 | Yes |
| Spa Club Membership | 12 | 30 | Flat fee | 350.00 | 50 | Yes |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 12 | 30 | Flat fee | 500.00 | 50 | Yes |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 12 | 30 | Flat fee | 750.00 | 50 | Yes |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 24 | 60 | Remaining-term dues | 0.00 (the flat fee basis does not apply) | 50 | Yes |

## The two bases of the early termination charge

- **Flat fee** — the charge is the fixed amount in the flat-fee column for the level. Five levels use this basis.
- **Remaining-term dues** — the charge is the dues of the months remaining in the minimum term. The Founders Resort Club Membership is the only level on this basis, and its flat-fee figure is 0.00 because no flat fee is set for it.

## Points read from the schedule

- The Fitness Club Membership has the shortest minimum term, 6 months; the Founders Resort Club Membership has the longest, 24 months; every other level has 12 months.
- The notice period is 30 calendar days at every level except the Founders Resort Club Membership, where it is 60 calendar days.
- The relocation distance is 50 miles at every level.
- At every level a cancellation or freeze notice takes effect only once the member has signed it.
